limits.handling: 310 individuals, ten HKSAR streams, August 2013–January 2014. Nine initial loci, seven retained after null-allele exclusions. Site populations are operational sampling units; coordinates withheld in source. Not current census or full range.

Heterozygosity and FST statistics describe sampled marker variation, not abundance, genomewide fitness or migration rate; SD labels retained. Pairwise mean FST .067 distinguished from global-FST wording in Discussion.

Principal K4 with some K9 support; admixture shared ancestry or exchange, not uniquely dated gene flow. Nonsignificant isolation by straight-line distance does not prove no distance effects; ten-site sample limitation.
